coverage.evidence: Required overlays come from GET overlays/required at server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Controllers/V1/WidgetsController.cs:152-172 over FirstPartyWidgetCatalogue.SystemSurfaceNaturalKeys, which includes alerts (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Content/Widgets/FirstPartyWidgetCatalogue.cs:60-69). The Overlays list leaves them out (dashboard/src/views/dashboard/overlays/OverlaysView.vue:56-59). Connect and Configure open the same Set up {name} in OBS dialog (dashboard/src/views/dashboard/overlays/components/ObsSetupAction.vue:12-15,148-160; dashboard/src/views/dashboard/obs/components/RequiredOverlaysPanel.vue:15,115-123). Duplicate uses POST clone at WidgetsController.cs:253-275. A clone has no gallery link (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Widgets/WidgetService.cs:177-179), so its settings come from settings.json (WidgetService.cs:734-750; server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Widgets/CustomWidgetSettingsDeclaration.cs:22-30). The kind badge comes from the events the widget listens to, with the first matching rule winning, and has no badge for PLAIN (dashboard/src/views/dashboard/overlays/components/overlayKind.ts:37-110; dashboard/src/views/dashboard/overlays/components/OverlayDetail.vue:258-264).

Test needs widget:write and fires at one widget only (server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Controllers/V1/WidgetTestEventController.cs:70-125). It reaches only a widget that is on and subscribes to the event (server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Hubs/Broadcasters/WidgetAlertRouting.cs:24-25). widget:write is Mod (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Content/Identity/ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:396). The editor samples come from the same table (WidgetTestEventController.cs:56-67). The preview runs tts_synthesize for real (server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Assets/editor/preview-sdk.js:60-67). A replay reruns the event response, including a bound command, action or pipeline (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Platform/Eventing/EventResponseExecutor.cs:202-215,497-498,540-579).

A replay rebuilds the chain from the event journal and re-sends captured alerts. It never publishes the event or reaches currency or reward services (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Dashboard/Replay/ActivityReplayService.cs:27-36,63-125). A gift bomb plays the gifter, then the recipients in order (ActivityReplayService.cs:139-158). NOT_FOUND and NOTHING_REPLAYED are refusals (ActivityReplayService.cs:97-115), and NOTHING_REPLAYED maps to a 409 (server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Controllers/BaseController.cs:351-354). The UI maps 409, 404 and other failures to the three messages and the success counts (dashboard/src/views/dashboard/events/components/ActivityRows.vue:39-68; dashboard/src/views/dashboard/home/i18n/en.json:144-150). dashboard:replay is Mod (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:434; server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Controllers/V1/DashboardController.cs:489-490).

tts_synthesize is the only action the preview runs for real, and it needs widget:write, which is Mod (server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Controllers/V1/WidgetPreviewActionController.cs:27-39,51-89; ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:396). Other actions log as 'Would run' (server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Assets/editor/editor.js:314; server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Assets/editor/preview.js:419). The page states the speech consequence before the steps for using samples (page lines 99-104).
